payload.title: CUTLASS Tutorial: Blackwell GEMM with Tensor Memory
payload.summary: A detailed walkthrough of Blackwell's fifth-generation Tensor Core MMA instructions (`tcgen05.mma`) and the dedicated Tensor Memory (TMEM) they operate on, based on the Colfax Research CUTLASS tutorial series.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.gist: NVIDIA Blackwell architecture introduces features that significantly change the implementation of GEMM kernels.

sections.heading: 2. Blackwell MMA Overview
sections.gist: Hopper's WGMMA instructions (`wgmma.mma_async` in PTX) are deprecated on Blackwell.

sections.heading: 3. Tensor Memory
sections.gist: **Tensor Memory (TMEM)** is on-chip memory dedicated to Tensor Core operations.

sections.heading: 4. tcgen05.mma Instruction

sections.heading: 5. tcgen05.ld Instruction
sections.gist: Three memory movement instructions exist under tcgen05: `ld`, `st`, and `cp`.

sections.heading: 6. CUTLASS UMMA Interface
sections.gist: The CuTe interface consists of `MMA_Atom` (PTX instruction wrapper) and `MMA_Traits` (CuTe layouts and metadata).

sections.heading: 7. CUTLASS Example: Simple UMMA
sections.gist: The example is organized into five parts.

sections.heading: 8. TMEM Allocation and Deallocation
sections.gist: The CuTe helper class `cute::TMEM::Allocator1Sm` provides an interface for `tcgen05.alloc` and `tcgen05.dealloc`.

sections.heading: 9. Conclusion
sections.gist: The main concepts and overall structure of CUTLASS GEMM kernels have not changed with Blackwell.
